group_label: Extra missions (Nadesico B, Ra Cailum, White Fang...)

glossary.ja: オーガニック・プレート
glossary.role: The disc-shaped plates Orphan produces, from which Antibodies are revived.
Computer voice prefix (alarm messages in katakana-robot speech).
Queen of the Kingdom of Na; commands the aura battleship Gran-Garan; gives Sho the Billbine
glossary.personality: Serene, dignified young queen with strong Aura Power and a sense of duty to all of Byston Well. Calm but resolute.

glossary.role: Aura battleship of Queen Ciela Lapana (Kingdom of Na)
Organic mecha born from Orphan plates (Grand Chers and Brains).
The people who serve Orphan and pilot Grand Chers to gather its plates; plural 'Reclaimers'
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers

Daba's rival. Ambitious country noble from Koam who joins the Poseidal military (under Chai Char, later one of the Thirteen); commands the Slender Skala, finally sides with Daba to rescue Quwasan. Pilots Ashura Temple, A-Taul, Bat-Shu in ACE2.
glossary.personality: Pompous and vain but sincere, warm-hearted and quick to fall in love; naive and comically airheaded, a rival with a sense of honor.

glossary.role: Orphan's disc plates sought by the Reclaimers; ALSO (crossover) inscribed plates carrying a Zentradi/Protoculture song.

report.translator_summary: Extra missions batch xa_05 translated. Covers conclusion of satellite interception mission (m6009) and space shuttle launch defense mission (m6010) featuring Gablae forces, Reclaimer intrusion, and Queen Ciela Lapana.
